subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class opt-in TUI run-completion notification, and if so should the supported contract be terminal bell only, desktop/node notification, configurable sound, or a narrower status-highlight behavior?
rationale: Current TUI exposes visual completion only, and the requested behavior adds user-facing notification, config, and platform semantics that repository policy should not treat as an automatic bug repair.

options.title: Start with terminal bell
options.body: Add an opt-in TUI-local bell on final/terminal run completion without introducing macOS-specific notification semantics first.

options.title: Design desktop notifications
options.body: Define a cross-platform desktop/node notification contract, permission behavior, and docs before implementation.

options.title: Defer to alert architecture
options.body: Track completion alerts under the broader gateway/session activity alert work instead of adding TUI-specific notification behavior now.

recommendation.title: Start with terminal bell
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in TUI-local bell on final/terminal run completion without introducing macOS-specific notification semantics first.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history signal for the TUI status surface and is the best available owner for the product/UX contract decision.
